text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... What a race! I've never paid
much
attention to Inari One before, but I
can't believe
how powerful she is!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she from outside the city, like
Oguri? Is
everyone out there this
amazing?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text:
That was a good start, Inari One! Just
keep it up
and continue making a name
for yourself! ...I
know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
Woo! That's our Inari! You're the pride
of Oi!

text_block_list.name: Townswoman
text_block_list.text:
Really... She's incredible! And to think
she used to
be such a tiny li'l thing! How
she's grown!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Wow, she's so cool... Inari's shinin' bright
as a star!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll needa break out the good
stuff tonight.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: YES! It feels like my trainin's paid off!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hang on. If Inari One can run this good,
why'd she
slip under the radar last year?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, a quick search says she mostly ran
G1s in
Oi... And, hmm... It looks like she
won the Tokyo
Daishoten too.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I had no idea! Guess she decided
to run
regional races first to get a few
victories under
her belt. You know, since
they're easier to win.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(My fireworks have barely got their
attention...
I'm not even close to bright
enough.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(I gotta do more! I gotta prove the
centrals are no
better than the
regionals!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...It's too early to get excited. My race to
the
top—to become Umamusume of the
Year—has
just started!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me 'n' I'll prove it to
ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I reunite with Inari One after her
amazing
victory, I notice a hard look on
her face, one I've
never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss... What race should I run in next?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss... What race should I run in next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After today's performance, her next
challenge
seems obvious. It has to be
the final big race of
the first half of the
year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So we're gonna bring the heat to a

medium-distance race, huh? Fine by me!
It'll be
just like today. I'm gonna—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No... I'm gonna do even better than I did
today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging from how well she did here, I'm
confident
she'll be able to run well at
the Takarazuka Kinen
too, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help but feel like something's off.
